Subject (in full) Movements of E. D. Lepin, Soviet Military Attaché.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiew Forwarded by J. Bayne D.S.I

Edward D. Lepin, 46, military attaché of the U.S.S.R.
Embassy in China, who left Shanghai for Peiping on August 7,
returned here from Tokio on August 24 in the s.s. President
Coolidge, accompanied by his wife, Mrs. Helene Lepin, 37.

G. Prokofiew.
D.S.I.

D.C. (Crime & Special Branches)

Copy sent to her 'B' 26/8

（印：RECEIVED 26 AUG 1936 CENTRAL BRANCH）

主题（全称）苏联武官 E. D. Lepin 的行踪。

由侦探副督察 Prokofiew 撰写 由侦探副督察 J. Bayne 转呈

Edward D. Lepin，46岁，苏联驻华大使馆武官，于8月7日离开上海前往北平，后于8月24日乘“柯立芝总统”号轮船（s.s. President Coolidge）从东京返回此处，由其妻子 Helene Lepin 夫人（37岁）陪同。

G. Prokofiew.
侦探副督察

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.I.
E.D. LEPIN, Military Attache of the U.S.S.R. Embassy in
China , left Shanghai for Peiping on August 7,1936, by aero-

Subject (in full) E.D. Lepin, Soviet Employee.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky Forwarded by J.B.Kn. D!

Edward Davidovitch Lepin, Russian of Latvian
origin, 45 years of age, Military Attache of the U.S.S.R.
Legation, arrived at Shanghai from Moscow on April 4, 1934
by the s.s. "Nagasaki Maru", accompanied by his wife. He
holds a Diplomatic passport No.2770 issued on 20.2.34 at
Moscow by the Peoples Commissariat of Foreign Affairs, bearing
Chinese visa issued by the Chinese Legation in Moscow on
2.2.34.

His wife Mrs. Helena Lepin is a Russian, 35 years
of age, holding U.S.S.R. passport No.2771.

Lepin resides at No.1 Whangpoo Road in the U.S.S.R.
Legation.

（批：4/16
32）

Tcheremshansky
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

主题（全称）苏联雇员 E.D. Lepin。

由侦探警佐 Tcheremshansky 撰写 由 J.B.Kn. 转呈！

Edward Davidovitch Lepin，拉脱维亚裔俄罗斯人，45岁，苏联公使馆武官，于1934年4月4日乘“长崎丸”号轮船（s.s. "Nagasaki Maru"）从莫斯科抵达上海，由其妻子陪同。他持有外交护照第2770号，该护照于1934年2月20日在莫斯科由苏联人民外交委员会签发，并附有中国驻莫斯科公使馆于1934年2月2日签发的中国签证。

其妻 Helena Lepin 夫人系俄罗斯人，35岁，持有苏联护照第2771号。

Lepin 居住在黄浦路1号苏联公使馆内。

（批注：4/16
32）

Tcheremshansky
侦探警佐

特别支部主管警官。
